lines.text: The LORD reigns, and righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.
A cloud goes before the LORD and consumes His foes, and His lightning lights up the world.
The mountains melt like wax, the heavens proclaim His righteousness, and those who boast in idols are put to shame.
Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Ephraim exult because the LORD is exalted far above all gods.
The LORD preserves His saints, light shines on the righteous, and the righteous are told to rejoice and praise His holy name.
